Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: In Step 4, the WebSurfer agent incorrectly interpreted search results regarding the nature of the 1887 agreement. The search results clearly indicated that the 1887 "Declaration of Amity and Commerce" was a treaty of friendship and trade (an "amicus" relationship), not a military alliance. The agent erroneously concluded this was an "alliance" and pivoted the task towards confirming 1887, ignoring the clear distinction made in the search snippets between the 1887 diplomatic treaty and the 1941 military alliance (Axis alignment) which is the standard historical answer for when Thailand and Japan formed a military alliance. This led the entire group down the wrong path, resulting in the wrong final answer (1887 instead of 1941).
